In a sunny outdoor park with lush green trees, the woman with curly dark hair (R1) and the man with long brown hair (R2) share an intimate kiss. On the left, the woman in a dark blue shirt with a black panel tilts her head up. On the right, the man in a blue plaid shirt leans down to press his lips to hers. A thick tree trunk stands directly behind them on the right. Bright, natural sunlight filters through the leaves, creating a warm, soft-focus background.
